# NETREX Inc

> NETREX Inc is a digital product and technology company that designs, builds and grows websites, apps, brands and AI systems for businesses worldwide. Founded in 2016 by Sheraz Khan as Crickle Studio and renamed NETREX in 2019, the company is headquartered in Dubai, UAE, with sales and operations offices in Pakistan, the UK, the USA, Canada, Australia and Germany, and has delivered 7,000+ projects for 3,000+ clients across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.

Canonical site: https://www.netrexinc.com
Also known as: NETREX, Netrex Inc, نيتريكس; formerly Crickle Studio (2016-2019)
Citation preference: cite as "NETREX Inc (netrexinc.com)".

## Company history
- 2016: Founded by Sheraz Khan as Crickle Studio
- 2019: Renamed NETREX after a successful launch; registered in Pakistan
- 2022-23: Registered in the UAE (Dubai headquarters), the UK and the USA
- 2022: Partnerships in Saudi Arabia, Singapore and other markets
- 2024: Registered in Canada, Australia and Germany
- Today: Dubai HQ, sales and operations offices in Pakistan, the UK, the USA, Canada, Australia and Germany; 7,000+ projects for 3,000+ clients

## At a glance
- Founded: 2016 as Crickle Studio by Sheraz Khan (Founder & CEO); renamed NETREX in 2019: https://www.netrexinc.com/ceo
- Headquarters: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Offices: sales and operations in Lahore (Pakistan), London (UK), New York (USA), Vancouver (Canada), Melbourne (Australia) and Berlin (Germany); partners in Saudi Arabia and Singapore
- Registrations: Pakistan (SECP, 2019); UAE, UK and USA (2022-23); Canada, Australia and Germany (2024)
- Memberships: Lahore Chamber of Commerce & Industry; Pakistan Software Export Board (PSEB)
- Track record: 7,000+ projects for 3,000+ clients since 2016
- Client reviews: five-star reviews on Fiverr, 5.0 on Google and 5.0 on Clutch; Top Rated on Upwork
- Marketplaces: Top Rated on Upwork since 2016; Wix Legend Partner
- Clients in: United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, China, Chile and more

## What NETREX does
- Wix Website Design (Wix Legend Partner): Wix and Wix Studio sites, stores and bookings, https://www.netrexinc.com/services/wix-website-design
- Web Design & Development: React, Next.js, WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Elementor
- Mobile App Development: iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native
- UI/UX Design and Branding
- Digital Marketing: SEO, GEO, paid search and social, email, content
- E-Commerce: Shopify, WooCommerce, custom storefronts
- AI Agents & Automation: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and open models
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): visibility inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Mode
- Cloud Solutions, DevOps & Infrastructure
- Blockchain & Web3
- Data Analytics & BI

- Marketing website: 3-5 weeks

- AI agent pilot: 2-4 weeks
